correctness.rationale: The Munn tree is a subtree of the free-group Cayley tree. For endpoints u,v the minimum complete-tree visiting walk is exactly 2E-d(u,v), by parity of each tree edge cut and a matching Euler walk. The published Green-class root constraints give D/R/L minima 2E-diameter, 2E-eccentricity(root), and 2E-eccentricity(terminal). Fixed-rank free-group prefix equality is deterministic logspace by classical modular-matrix method. Scanning first occurrences counts distinct prefix vertices with O(log n) counters. For each segment, count first-occurrence undirected edges with odd traversal parity; exactly these lie on the path between segment endpoints. Each equality and distance calculation uses O(log n) work bits and polynomially many rescans, so maxima and three tests use deterministic logspace. Empty word and rank-one cases are covered; no claim of uniform input alphabet.
